title: markdown
description: Markdown text: paragraphs, headings, lists, emphasis, code and links. Raw HTML is shown as text, never run. {{color:<role>}} names a palette color in the deck language.

md.description: The Markdown source. May contain data bindings such as {{data/summary.json#/responders | ,.0f}}, and color words such as {{color:accent}}, which become the palette's name for that color role in the deck language (blue, azul). An unknown role is an error.
